ar.title: السوتيه

steps.n1: نحضر إناء الطهي وبه ماء وملح وبصلة صحيحة وخل.
steps.n2: بعد الغليان نسكب الخضار ونهدئ درجة الحرارة حتى ينضج، ثم نرفعه في مصفاة.
steps.n3: نحضر صحنا غويطا به زيت وليمون وملح وفلفل ويقلبوا جيدا، ثم نضيف فيه الخضار.

en.title: Sauté Vegetables

steps.n1: Prepare a cooking pot with water, salt, a whole onion, and vinegar.
steps.n2: Once boiling, add the vegetables and lower the heat until cooked through, then drain them in a colander.
steps.n3: Prepare a deep bowl with oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, mixing them well, then add the vegetables to it.

legacySteps: Prepare a cooking pot with water, salt, a whole onion, and vinegar.
Once boiling, add the vegetables and lower the heat until cooked through, then drain them in a colander.
Prepare a deep bowl with oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, mixing them well, then add the vegetables to it.
